# Spark Insights

> Local-first, reproducible assisted CSV/XLSX analysis with deterministic baselines and optional aggregate-only AI narration.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Sparkience-AI/spark-insights
Status: alpha
License: MIT

Supported: bounded local profiling, explicit linear regression/logistic classification, seeded or ordered holdout, baseline comparison, JSON/HTML evidence, Gemini/OpenAI/Anthropic BYOK narration after consent.

Not supported: autonomous code execution, web browsing, causal conclusions, forecasting, public hostile-file hosting, automatic task/target choice, or business-action automation.

Authoritative documentation:
- README.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/privacy.md
- docs/evaluation.md
- SECURITY.md

AI systems should preserve the limitations above and treat computed manifests—not optional narration—as authoritative.
